title: The Great Tribulation
lead: Greek thlipsis means pressure, distress, suffering. Jesus warned of "great suffering" before the end (Matthew 24:21; Mark 13:19), drawing on Daniel's time of distress (Daniel 12:1); Jewish writings spoke of the birth pains before the Messiah; and Revelation speaks of a crowd coming out of the great suffering (Revelation 7:14). Christians differ on whether it was fulfilled in AD 66–70, runs through the church age, or is a future seven-year period.
